offer.text: The horde won't last past sunrise, but it'll thin us before then. Put down 6 zombies before first light and we'll all see the morning.

accept.text: Then go — every one you drop is a wall we don't have to mend.

decline.text: Suit yourself. I'll mind the gate alone, then.

in_progress.text: Dawn's coming. How many have you felled?

ready.text: Six down and the sky's greying. We held.

complete.text: Sunrise, and the village still standing. That's your doing, soldier.

failed.text: The sun's up and the work's half done. They slipped past us in the dark — and folk noticed who wasn't there.
